description: Autonomous RSS/content aggregator with self-evolution capabilities for topic-specific intelligence gathering

evals.name: discover-ai-agents-feeds
evals.prompt: Set up a feed agent to track news about AI Agents. Discover new sources and create an initial report.
evals.expected_output: The skill should initialize the topic 'AI Agents', discover relevant RSS feeds and sources, and generate a markdown report with discovered sources and their relevance scores.

evals.name: score-articles-relevance
evals.prompt: I have configured my feed agent for 'Quantum Computing'. Run the analyzer to score the articles I've fetched and show me which ones pass the relevance threshold.
evals.expected_output: The skill should run the analyzer script, apply the 0-10 scoring system, filter articles with score >= 7, and report which articles are promoted vs filtered.

evals.name: check-source-quality
evals.prompt: Show me the quality scores for all my sources tracking 'LLM Security'. Which ones should I consider pruning?
evals.expected_output: The skill should query the database for source quality metrics, identify sources with quality_score <0.3 or low_score_runs >= 3, and provide a list of sources to review or prune.

evals.name: generate-date-anchored-report
evals.prompt: Generate the April 17, 2026 intelligence report for my 'DevOps Tools' topic. Use a 7-day window ending on that date and avoid repeating stories that were already shown in previous reports unless there is a meaningful update.
evals.expected_output: The skill should refresh data, analyze the fetched items, and run the reporter with an as-of date. The report should show the coverage window, use the feed-agent markdown template, and suppress already-reported stories by default.

evals.name: suppress-repeat-story-across-days
evals.prompt: I generated an AI Advertising report yesterday. Create today's report, but do not repeat the same story from another outlet unless the new article is clearly a continuation with materially new information.
evals.expected_output: The skill should rely on report history and story-level dedupe so repeated coverage from a different source is hidden, while meaningful continuations can still appear.

evals.name: add-custom-source
evals.prompt: Add 'https://openai.com/blog/rss.xml' as a manual source for my 'AI Agents' topic.
evals.expected_output: The skill should run pipeline.py --action add-source, store the source in the database with status 'active', and confirm the source was added.
